checksums.name: none_identified
checksums.formula_detail: No checksum/CRC routine was found in the provided decompilation (86 functions), and no byte range in the populated region (0x0-0x41F) numerically matches sum8/xor8/sum16le of any neighboring span. Swept sum8(0x0-0x420)=0x50, xor8(0x0-0x420)=0x04, sum16le(0x0-0x420)=0x4e98, sum8(0x0-0x1000)=0xd7, xor8(0x0-0x1000)=0x5f against all stored byte/u16 values in the file; no match found. Absence is reported, not proven, since only one non-blank sample is available.

io_driver_functions.notes: Flash chip-ID autoselect: 0xAA/0x55/0x90 unlock+ID-entry, reads 2 ID bytes via func_0x08099860, then 0xAA/0x55/0xF0 ID-exit/reset. MMIO seed function.

Calls FUN_08098c5c to get chip ID, scans a chip-descriptor table on the 16-bit ID field at +0x28, copies matched chip parameters + driver function pointer (+0x14) into globals, tail-calls it via unresolved jumptable.
Bank-switch/timing copy helper using a ^1-toggled pointer countdown loop; called explicitly by the sector-erase routine, and its body is independently inlined inside 0x08098fbc and 0x080990dc.
Multi-byte Flash program, bank-relative addressing form: builds (param_1<<shift)+param_2+0xE000000 and calls func_0x08099858(addr,data,count,scratch). Caller unresolved (jumptable).
Multi-byte Flash program, fixed-base addressing form; invoked as the retry path from the write+verify loop at 0x08099194.
Write-with-verify loop: up to 3 attempts of func_0x08099854 (compare) + FUN_080990dc (reprogram) until verification succeeds. Caller unresolved (jumptable).

4KB sector erase (guarded by sector index < 0x10, i.e. 16 sectors = 64KB total). Writes 0xAA/0x55/0x80, 0xAA/0x55/0x30 sector-erase command sequence, calls bank-switch helper 0x08098ed4, polls completion via func_0x08099858. MMIO seed function. Caller unresolved (jumptable).
Single-byte Flash program: 0xAA/0x55/0xA0 command then func_0x08099858(1,dst,byte,...). Caller unresolved (jumptable).

open_questions: What code builds the PIRO payload, the 216x0x00008CA0 table, and the 10-record block? Not present in the provided 86-function decompilation.
What resolves the UNRECOVERED_JUMPTABLE dispatches that gate nearly every Flash driver entry point, i.e. who actually calls into this driver from game logic?
Is there a checksum/CRC at all? Only one non-blank sample exists; a second sample with different payload bytes is required to test cumulative-sum/CRC hypotheses.
What do the trailer values 0x0000C350 (50000), 0x4016, and 0xD24C at offsets 0x0420/0x042C/0x042E represent?
Is the 0xFF byte at +0xC of each 16-byte record a per-slot 'unused' flag, a string terminator, or something else? All 10 observed records are identical, so no contrastive evidence exists yet.
Is 10 records a meaningful fixed table size (e.g. a roster/ranking table), or an artifact specific to this capture?
